battery_gbp_per_mwh.source: Modo Energy 2026 Capex Survey: containerised BESS cost per MWh (GB median; range 4h to 2h median)
battery_gbp_per_mwh.quote: Sheet 'By region', row GB, 'Container $/MWh' = 133510.08; sheet 'By duration', 'Containerised BESS $/MWh': 2h (1.5-2.5h) = 151427.03, 4h (3.5-4.5h) = 128229.41
battery_gbp_per_mwh.derivation: USD to GBP at 1.3563 USD/GBP (Bank of England XUDLUSS, 9 Sep 2026, the survey's publication day), rounded to £100: low 128229.41/1.3563, mid 133510.08/1.3563, high 151427.03/1.3563

balance_of_plant_gbp_per_mw.source: Modo Energy 2026 Capex Survey: PCS + balance of plant per MW (grid connection excluded; the model prices the cable separately)
balance_of_plant_gbp_per_mw.quote: Sheet 'Summary', cost stack (all durations): PCS median $/MW 98742.05, mean 115488.98; Balance of plant median 193021.78, mean 191987.01. Sheet 'Cost stack by region', Europe: PCS 39.23, Balance of plant 62.22 ($k/MWh). Note in sheet: 'cost-line medians are independent and do not sum exactly to the total median.'

opex_gbp_per_mw_year.source: Modo Energy 2026 Capex Survey: annual opex (median, p10, p90; some responses include the optimiser fee)
opex_gbp_per_mw_year.quote: Sheet 'Opex': 'Median $/MW/year' 20000; '10th percentile $/MW/year' 8447.18; '90th percentile $/MW/year' 44942.51; 'Includes optimiser fee' 28405.25; 'Excludes optimiser fee' 12985.26
opex_gbp_per_mw_year.derivation: USD to GBP at 1.3563: 20000/1.3563, 8447.18/1.3563, 44942.51/1.3563, rounded to £100. Global survey, not GB-only

revenue_2h_gbp_per_mw_year.source: Modo Energy ME BESS GB: 2h revenue, 12 months to April 2026 (includes Capacity Market); range = lowest and highest monthly index readings in that window
revenue_2h_gbp_per_mw_year.quote: 'A typical two-hour GB BESS earned £73,145/MW/year over the twelve months to April 2026' (mid). Low: 'Battery energy storage revenues in Great Britain fell to £41k/MW/year in February' (https://modoenergy.com/research/en/me-bess-gb-revenues-february-2026-wholesale-battery-energy-storage-balancing-mechanism, 2026-03-05). High: 'fell to £59k/MW/year in November, down from £77k/MW/year in October' (https://modoenergy.com/research/en/me-bess-gb-battery-energy-storage-revenues-november-2025-balancing-mechanism-gas-wind, 2025-12-04)
revenue_2h_gbp_per_mw_year.derivation: low and high are single-month annualised readings, so the range is wider than a full-year range would be

revenue_4h_gbp_per_mw_year.source: PLACEHOLDER - legacy value, not verified. No public GB 4h revenue figure found (Modo, Cornwall Insight and Aurora publish 4h indices and forecasts behind paywalls). Needs a public 4h benchmark or a licensed feed

revenue_8h_gbp_per_mw_year.source: PLACEHOLDER - legacy value, not verified. The only public 8h figure found is a Modo full-horizon forecast average (£192k/MW/year), not a current actual and not on the same basis as the 2h figure
revenue_8h_gbp_per_mw_year.note: Modo Energy, 'July 2026 GB BESS Forecast update' (https://modoenergy.com/research/en/july-2026-gb-forecast-bess-update-modelling-non-physical-trading, 2026-07-16): 'An 8h asset's average revenue rises from £173k to £192k/MW/year (+11.2%)'

cable_33kv_gbp_per_km.source: NGED South West Statement of Methodology and Charges for Connection, June 2026, section 7.44 cable charges, 33kV additional metres of mains cable
cable_33kv_gbp_per_km.quote: 'Extension of 33kV mains cable' - 'Additional metres of mains cable m': prepared trench 241 / 524; typical footpath or carriageway 225 / 841; unmade ground 154 / 355 (columns 'Min Max', £ per metre)
cable_33kv_gbp_per_km.derivation: low = unmade ground min £154/m x 1000; high = footpath or carriageway max £841/m x 1000; mid = (low + high)/2. Excludes traffic management, wayleaves and final connection (paras 7.46-7.48)

cable_132kv_gbp_per_km.source: NGED South West Statement of Methodology and Charges for Connection, June 2026, section 7.44 cable charges, 132kV additional metres of mains cable
cable_132kv_gbp_per_km.quote: 'Extension of 132kV mains cable' - 'Additional metres of mains cable m': prepared trench 361 / 692; typical footpath or carriageway 3,171 / 3,171; unmade ground 2,119 / 2,119 (£ per metre)
cable_132kv_gbp_per_km.derivation: low = unmade ground £2,119/m x 1000; high = footpath or carriageway £3,171/m x 1000; mid = (low + high)/2. Prepared-trench rows exclude civils, so they are not used

crossing_uplift_pct.source: PLACEHOLDER - team modelling choice, no published source. NGED's cable table prices carriageway and unmade ground separately, which could replace this uplift

cable_detour_factor.source: PLACEHOLDER - team modelling choice (screening rule of thumb), no published source

otcf_gbp_per_mw.source: Ofgem CMP470 minded-to consultation: Oversubscribed Technologies Commitment Fee (proposed, not in force)
otcf_gbp_per_mw.quote: para 3.18: 'The OTCF would be introduced at £3,000/MW and reviewed every six months. Where oversubscription has not reduced sufficiently, the OTCF would first increase to £5,000/MW and then in £5,000/MW increments every 6 months up to a maximum of £25,000/MW.'
otcf_gbp_per_mw.note: The OTCF is a security floor returned on energisation (para 3.2), not a sunk cost; first securities payable from October 2027 (para 3.23)

otcf_on_above_pct.source: Ofgem CMP470 minded-to consultation, activation threshold
otcf_on_above_pct.quote: para 3.14: 'The mechanism would activate when oversubscription exceeds 50% and be disapplied once oversubscription falls below 25%.'

otcf_off_below_pct.source: Ofgem CMP470 minded-to consultation, deactivation threshold
otcf_off_below_pct.quote: para 3.14: 'The mechanism would activate when oversubscription exceeds 50% and be disapplied once oversubscription falls below 25%.'

oversubscription_pct.source: Ofgem CMP470 minded-to consultation: BESS operational + Gate 2 capacity vs Clean Power 2030 requirement
oversubscription_pct.quote: Executive summary: 'presently around 90GW of operational and Gate 2 Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) capacity currently exists, against an estimated Clean Power 2030 requirement of around 29GW by 2035.'
oversubscription_pct.derivation: (90 - 29) / 29 = 210% above the requirement. Para 2.5 gives the split: 7GW operational + ~83GW Gate 2

availability_pct.source: Gore Street Energy Storage Fund, audited full-year results to 31 March 2026: average asset availability
availability_pct.publisher: Gore Street Energy Storage Fund plc
availability_pct.quote: 'Average asset availability of 94.5% during the year (31 March 2025: 95.3%).'
availability_pct.note: Fleet includes GB, Northern Ireland, Ireland, Germany and Texas assets, not GB only

curtailment_haircut.source: PLACEHOLDER - team modelling choice, no published source. Needs a DNO flexible-connection curtailment study or a NESO/DNO curtailment dataset for the site's constraint zone

debt_share_pct.source: Gresham House Energy Storage Fund: senior project finance for three GB BESS projects, May 2026
debt_share_pct.publisher: Gresham House Energy Storage Fund plc
debt_share_pct.quote: 'This financing includes £141 million in senior debt from a syndicate of four lenders, covering up to 70% of project costs, with repayment profiles of at least 15 years and legal maturities of 10 years, priced at 250bps over SONIA.'
debt_share_pct.note: 'up to 70%' is a ceiling from one deal; no public low figure found, so low = mid = high

interest_rate_pct.source: SONIA (Bank of England) + 250bps senior margin (Gresham House, May 2026); low = SONIA + 160bps export-credit facility
interest_rate_pct.publisher: Gresham House Energy Storage Fund plc; Bank of England
interest_rate_pct.quote: Gresham House: 'priced at 250bps over SONIA' and 'Export credit agency-backed facilities ... at a fixed rate priced off SONIA + 160bps' (interim results, 23 Sep 2026, https://www.investegate.co.uk/announcement/rns/gresham-house-energy-storage-fund--grid/interim-results-for-period-ended-30-june-2026/9785600). Bank of England IUDSOIA 22-23 Sep 2026: 3.7305
interest_rate_pct.derivation: mid = 3.7305 + 2.50 = 6.2305; low = 3.7305 + 1.60 = 5.3305; rounded to 2 dp. SONIA from https://www.bankofengland.co.uk/boeapps/database/_iadb-fromshowcolumns.asp?csv.x=yes&Datefrom=01/Sep/2026&Dateto=26/Sep/2026&SeriesCodes=XUDLUSS,IUDSOIA,IUDBEDR&CSVF=TN&UsingCodes=Y&VPD=Y&VFD=N

arrangement_fee_pct.source: PLACEHOLDER - legacy value, not verified. No public UK BESS arrangement fee found; lenders do not disclose upfront fees in RNS announcements

discount_rate_pct.source: Listed GB BESS fund NAV discount rates: Gresham House WADR (Q1 2026), Gore Street WADR (FY to Mar 2026); high = Gresham House levered rate
discount_rate_pct.publisher: Gresham House Energy Storage Fund plc; Gore Street Energy Storage Fund plc
discount_rate_pct.quote: Gresham House: 'Weighted average discount rate (WADR) is 10.36% for the full portfolio compared to 10.33% at 31 December 2025.' Gore Street (https://www.gsenergystoragefund.com/content/news/archive/2026/150726.asp, 2026-07-15): 'a slight increase in the weighted average discount rate to 10.25%'. Gresham House HY trading update (https://www.investegate.co.uk/announcement/rns/gresham-house-energy-storage-fund--grid/trading-update-for-hy-results-to-30-june-2026/9750396): 'the discount rate applied to levered cashflows will be one percentage point higher than on unlevered projects.'
discount_rate_pct.derivation: high = 10.36 + 1.00 (levered). The model discounts equity cash flows after debt service, which is the levered case

loan_term_years.source: Gresham House Energy Storage Fund: senior project finance, May 2026 (amortisation profile 15+ years, legal maturity 10 years)
loan_term_years.publisher: Gresham House Energy Storage Fund plc
loan_term_years.quote: 'The facilities each have a repayment profile of at least 15 years, and the legal maturity is 10 years.'

project_life_years.source: PLACEHOLDER - legacy value, not verified. No public GB lithium-ion BESS asset-life assumption found. Context only: Ofgem LDES cap and floor contracts run 25 years, which is a support term, not an asset life

hurdle_irr_pct.source: PLACEHOLDER - no published hurdle IRR. Proxy: the levered discount rate that listed GB BESS funds apply (Gresham House WADR 10.36% + 1pp for levered cash flows). Team to confirm
hurdle_irr_pct.publisher: Gresham House Energy Storage Fund plc
hurdle_irr_pct.quote: 'the discount rate applied to levered cashflows will be one percentage point higher than on unlevered projects.'
